# Moonshine C ABI header

`moonshine-c-api.h` is copied unchanged from Moonshine Voice v0.1.5,
commit `234f60faa0eb388b01cdf7e60aca232af37aefda`.
SHA-256: `e5c9038c4987d87f40abd78f843bd6ab0bff96a5ffd1cc2557c5531b0cbab21f`.
Source: https://github.com/moonshine-ai/moonshine/blob/v0.1.5/core/moonshine-c-api.h

The header is MIT-licensed; the upstream license is preserved alongside it.
Its discussion of legacy non-streaming weights does not apply to this header.
No runtime library, ONNX Runtime or model weights are vendored here.
The optional library is loaded dynamically; its matching ONNX Runtime library
and redistribution notices must accompany any binary package.
